seo_title: custom Food Tours Malaysia | Custom Routes
seo_description: Design a completely custom food tour in Malaysia. Tell us your interests, dietary needs, and schedule. We build a route nobody else gets.
hero_subtitle: Not an existing tour run privately. A completely custom route designed around your interests, your pace, and what you want to taste.
what_subtitle: A private tour takes an existing route and runs it for your group only. A custom experience builds a new route from scratch around what you actually want.

what_cards.title: Custom route, not a preset
what_cards.detail: We don't adjust an existing tour. Your guide designs a route from scratch based on your brief. Different neighbourhoods, different stalls, different dishes.

what_cards.title: Pre-tour planning call
what_cards.detail: Before anything is booked, you talk to your guide on WhatsApp. You discuss what you want to eat, how much you can walk, what you've tried before, what you're curious about.

what_cards.title: Any duration, any format
what_cards.detail: Three hours, six hours, a full day, a multi-city itinerary. A food crawl, a market deep-dive, a heritage walk with tastings. The format serves the experience, not the other way around.

process_steps.title: Tell us what you want
process_steps.description: Send us a WhatsApp or email. Tell us who's coming, what you're curious about, any dietary needs, and your dates. The more detail you give, the better the route.

process_steps.title: Your guide responds with a plan
process_steps.description: Within 24 hours, your guide replies with a proposed route. Neighbourhoods, stalls, dishes, timing. You refine it together until it feels right.

process_steps.title: We book the stalls
process_steps.description: Once you're happy with the plan, we confirm with each stall, arrange logistics, and brief your guide on every detail of your route.

process_steps.title: You show up and eat
process_steps.description: Your guide meets you at the agreed point. Everything else is handled. Adjustments on the day are always possible.

use_cases.label: Returning guests
use_cases.detail: You did Flavours of Malaysia last time. You want to go deeper into a specific neighbourhood or cuisine. We build a route that goes where the first tour didn't.

use_cases.label: Serious foodies
use_cases.detail: You've done the research. You want the char kway teow stall that uses charcoal, the laksa stall that makes its own paste, the kuih lady who only sells on certain days.

use_cases.label: Journalists & creators
use_cases.detail: Filming, writing, researching. You need access, stories, and a guide who can get you behind the counter. We've done this with BBC, National Geographic, and independent creators.

use_cases.label: Milestone trips
use_cases.detail: Birthdays, anniversaries, honeymoons. You want the day to feel different from a standard tour. We design the route around the occasion.

examples_subtext: Every custom route is different. These are real examples of what we've designed for past guests.

examples.title: The Durian Pilgrimage
examples.description: A 5-hour route for a guest who wanted to understand durian beyond the tourist stalls. Started at a durian farm outside Penang, ended at a specialist stall in George Town where we tasted 7 varieties. Included a stop at a durian paste maker.

examples.title: Hawker Dynasty Tour
examples.description: Built for a food writer. Visited three hawker stalls run by different generations of the same family. Each stop traced how the recipes changed (or didn't) across 60 years. Ended at the grandchild's modern reinterpretation.

examples.title: Vegetarian KL Deep Dive
examples.description: A guest who'd been told KL was hard for vegetarians. We built a route through Little India, Kampung Baru, and a Chinese vegetarian stall hidden above a hardware shop. Six stops, all plant-based, all deeply local.

pricing_body: Because every custom experience is built from scratch, pricing depends on duration, number of stops, and group size. Most routes fall between RM 400 and RM 1,200 per group. Send us your brief and we'll come back with a quote within 24 hours.

faqs.name: How is this different from a private tour?
faqs.answer: A private tour takes one of our existing routes (Flavours of Malaysia, KL Street Food, etc.) and runs it for your group only. A custom experience builds a completely new route based on your brief. Different stalls, different neighbourhoods, different dishes. If you want our existing tour without strangers, book private. If you want something that doesn't exist yet, book custom.

faqs.name: How much does it cost?
faqs.answer: It depends on duration and scope. A 3-hour custom route for two people starts around RM 400. A full-day multi-stop experience for a group of eight can be RM 1,000+. Send us your brief and we'll quote within 24 hours, no obligation.

faqs.name: How far ahead should we enquire?
faqs.answer: Two weeks minimum for a custom route. Your guide needs time to visit stalls, check opening hours, and brief vendors. We've done it in less when we had to, but the route is better with planning time.

faqs.name: Can you handle complex dietary requirements?
faqs.answer: This is where custom shines. If you're vegan, gluten-free, Jain, or have severe allergies, a custom route lets us hand-pick stalls that can accommodate you properly, rather than working around it on a standard route. Tell us your needs when you enquire.

faqs.name: Can you arrange transport between stops?
faqs.answer: Yes. For routes that span multiple neighbourhoods, we can arrange Grab transport or a private vehicle. This is quoted separately based on the route.

private_callout: Want an existing tour run just for your group? Private tours use our standard routes with no strangers.
